title: The Cranberries: Dreams and Dolores
imageHint: The distinctive voice behind "Zombie" and "Dreams" - ethereal Irish rock at its finest
description: From Limerick's church halls to global stardom, The Cranberries created a unique sound anchored by Dolores O'Riordan's haunting vocals and deeply personal lyrics about love, loss, and Irish identity.

questions.question: What was The Cranberries' breakthrough hit single from their 1993 debut album "Everybody Else Is Doing It, So Why Can't We?"?
questions.explanation: "Dreams" became their signature song and first major hit, showcasing Dolores O'Riordan's distinctive vocal style and the band's dreamy alternative rock sound.

questions.question: Which politically charged Cranberries song was written in response to the IRA bombing in Warrington that killed two children?
questions.explanation: "Zombie" (1994) was O'Riordan's passionate response to the Troubles in Northern Ireland, specifically the 1993 Warrington bombings. The song became a powerful anti-violence anthem.

questions.question: What was the original name of the band before Dolores O'Riordan joined and they became The Cranberries?
questions.explanation: The band was originally called The Cranberry Saw Us when formed in 1989. When Dolores joined, they shortened it to The Cranberries, which also worked as a play on their Irish heritage.

questions.question: Which Cranberries album featured the hit "Linger" but was actually recorded before their debut album was released?
questions.explanation: "Linger" was actually written in 1990 and recorded for demo tapes, but didn't become a major hit until 1993. It appeared on "No Need to Argue" (1994) after being re-recorded.

questions.question: What vocal technique did Dolores O'Riordan use that became her signature sound, involving rapid alternation between chest and head voice?
questions.explanation: O'Riordan incorporated Irish traditional keening and yodeling techniques into her rock vocals, creating her distinctive ethereal sound that influenced countless alternative rock singers.
